postal_system.full_code_format: IM plus one digit and an optional alphanumeric outward character, one inward digit and two letters; normally displayed with one space before the final three characters
postal_system.outward_code_format: IM plus one digit and an optional alphanumeric character, including the observed IM1 through IM9 and IM99 groups
postal_system.assignment_rule: A current unit postcode is a Royal Mail and Isle of Man Post Office routing assignment. Syntax, an ONSPD row, a PQI 9 placeholder, a post-box point, a post-office point, a constituency or another government boundary does not prove a Polygon/MultiPolygon for the unit postcode.
postal_system.normalization_rule: Trim, uppercase, remove internal whitespace for validation, require ^IM\d[A-Z\d]?\d[A-Z]{2}$, then display one space before the final three characters. Preserve the code as text. Normalization does not prove that the code is live or geographic.
postal_system.full_code_geometry_rule: Serve an exact unit-postcode surface only from an authoritative or rights-cleared real Polygon/MultiPolygon explicitly related to that current unit code. Never buffer, Voronoi-partition or dissolve a point, placeholder coordinate, delivery route, PO box, organisation or address list into a postcode polygon.
postal_system.outward_code_geometry_rule: An outward-code or postal-district context surface may be served only from a complete authoritative or rights-cleared real postal boundary release with deterministic current unit-code membership, edition, date, CRS, topology, coverage, exceptions, terms and SHA-256. It must be labelled as broader postal context and never as the exact unit-postcode geometry.
postal_system.po_box_route_organization_rule: Non-geographic, large-user, PO-box, route and organisation codes remain non-area. IM99 and every other code require source-defined classification; the outward text alone is not enough to infer an area.
postal_system.address_rule: A postcode finder result or ONSPD assignment is not permission to publish an address, recipient, occupant, delivery instruction or customer record. Address identity requires a separately authorised source and purpose.
postal_system.building_rule: Exact building output requires an explicit rights-cleared relation from an address or postcode assignment to a building feature. A post-box/post-office point, postcode membership, proximity, point containment or shared text does not establish a building relation.
postal_system.administrative_rule: Isle of Man constituencies, sheadings, parishes, government service areas and other administrative layers remain separate context. None may be relabelled as a unit-postcode or outward-code perimeter.
postal_system.licence_rule: Every ONS, Isle of Man Post Office, Isle of Man Government GIS or other artifact pins provider, exact URL, capture time, edition/effective date, terms, attribution, scope, bytes and SHA-256. ONS OGL reuse does not create geometry that the source withholds; public Finder access and an internal API reference do not authorize crawling or redistribution.
postal_system.territory_rule: The IM pack preserves Isle of Man identity. It does not merge the United Kingdom, Ireland, the Channel Islands or another territory and does not treat ONS inclusion as a change in postal or territorial authority.

integration.postcode_flow: normalized IM unit postcode -> current rights-cleared assignment -> truthful exact non-area/unavailable reason or explicit unit surface -> separately labelled rights-cleared outward-code context when available -> explicit address/building relation from separate authority -> IM AGID cells
integration.coordinate_flow: honest no-coordinate result or competent source coordinate -> optional separately labelled postal context Polygon/MultiPolygon -> explicit address-to-building relation -> rights-cleared building -> IM AGID cell
integration.building_output_gate: current postcode or address identity plus an explicit source-defined rights-cleared building identifier/relation and exact building geometry

quality_gates.pass: Every code remains text, normalizes to the country grammar with one display space and distinguishes syntax from a live assignment.
The nationwide live IM unit-postcode denominator pins edition, effective date, update cadence, terms, coverage, exceptions, byte length and SHA-256.
Every displayed exact unit surface comes from an explicit competent Polygon/MultiPolygon relation; PQI 9, null geometry and placeholder coordinates remain unavailable rather than being fabricated.
Every broader outward-code context comes from a complete authoritative or rights-cleared real postal-boundary release and is labelled separately from the searched unit code.
ONS, Isle of Man Post Office and government GIS terms and attributions remain enforceable per artifact; interactive or internal API access is never treated as bulk or public-serving authority.
Postcode assignment, postal context area, post-box/post-office point, address, building, administration, occupancy and ownership remain distinct authorities and relations.
No resident, recipient, occupant, owner, rightsholder, personal contact, delivery instruction, title/value, credential or customer record is published.
Generic IM planning cells and synthetic fixtures verify behavior only and never satisfy production M2 evidence.

stages.definition: Country-specific contracts, authority separation and synthetic conformance fixtures are reviewable.

A current rights-cleared nationwide Isle of Man unit-postcode denominator and an authoritative or rights-cleared real Polygon/MultiPolygon explicitly corresponding to every searchable geographic unit postcode, or an honest source-defined non-area classification plus a separately labelled real outward-code postal context surface, are pinned by edition, effective date, terms, attribution, CRS, topology, coverage, exceptions and SHA-256 and published as an approved immutable artifact. Searching a normalized IM postcode through the real AGID API/app must preserve unit versus broader-context grain, fit and render the eligible surface with translucent fill and a clear outline, and show selected code, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date, confidence and any non-area reason. ONSPD PQI 9 placeholders, null geometry, 99.999999 or rounded 100 latitude, longitude 0, post-box/post-office points, addresses, routes, PO boxes, organisations, constituencies, administrative areas, buffers, Voronoi cells and synthetic fixtures never satisfy M2.
Complete rights-cleared address membership and coordinates pass derivation, topology, coverage, uncertainty and correction gates for explicitly derived postal context only.
Licensed address identity and exact rights-cleared building relationships pass identifier, privacy, CRS, coverage and redistribution gates.
